why: Redeveloped as a hotel, read 2026-10-30: RV Life marks it 'Permanently Closed' (newest reviews 2016-17); Cheeca Holdings bought the 110-site bayfront park at 99010 Overseas Hwy in Dec 2015 to build a resort (hotel-online.com / therealdeal.com 2016); bungalowskeylargo.com now gives 99010 Overseas Highway as the address of Bungalows Key Largo, an all-inclusive resort opened 2019; Esri satellite at the RV Life pin 25.08944,-80.44668 (rendered, read) shows rows of identical bungalow roofs, pools and a beach club, with no RV pads.
name: Point Of View Key Largo RV Resort
flags: Not a temporary hurricane closure: the land is now the Bungalows Key Largo resort (no RV sites), so it is closed for good.
